title: Minor Cold Season
prompt: Describe the characteristics of the Minor Cold season.
hint: Mention the typical weather and activities during this time.
sample: The Minor Cold season, around January 6th, is often the coldest time of the year with breath turning to white mist and people eating warm lamb soup.

title: Counting the Nine Nines of Winter
prompt: Explain the tradition of counting the nine nines of winter.
hint: Describe how the counting starts and what it signifies.
sample: Starting from the winter solstice, people count 81 days in nine groups of nine, marking the passage of winter until spring arrives.

ja.hint: 数え始める時期とその意味を述べてください。
ja.sample: 冬至から始まり、9つのグループに分けて81日間数えます。これにより冬の終わりと春の訪れを示します。

title: Appreciating Warmth in the Coldest Winter
prompt: Describe how people appreciate warmth during the coldest winter days.
hint: Include examples of food and feelings during this time.
sample: During the coldest winter, people enjoy warm lamb soup and spicy hot pot, which help them appreciate warmth the most.

ja.sample: 最も寒い冬には、人々は温かい羊肉のスープや辛い鍋料理を楽しみ、温かさを一層感じます。
